get.description: Retrieve a list of CRM lists in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter the lists by their IDs and optionally include filters applied to the lists. It is useful for managing and organizing your CRM data by accessing specific lists.

parameters.name: includeFilters
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include filters applied to the lists in the response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: listIds
parameters.description: An array of list IDs to filter the lists returned. Each ID should be a string.

post.description: Create a new list in your HubSpot account using the specified parameters. This endpoint allows you to define the properties and criteria for the list, which can be used for organizing and managing contacts or other CRM objects.
Retrieve all lists in the CRM system. This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of all available lists, which can be useful for managing and organizing your CRM data effectively.

get.description: Retrieve a list of folders within the CRM lists. This endpoint can be used to navigate through the folder structure by specifying a folder ID. It is useful for organizing and managing lists within folders.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the folder to retrieve. Defaults to '0' if not specified.

post.description: Create a new folder within the CRM lists in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to organize your lists into folders for better management and accessibility.

put.description: Move a list to a different folder within your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying the list and the target folder. It is useful for organizing lists into different categories or structures.

delete.description: Delete a specific folder within the CRM lists by providing the folder's unique identifier. This operation is useful for removing folders that are no longer needed or to clean up the folder structure within your CRM lists.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the folder to delete.

put.description: Move a folder to a new parent folder within the CRM lists. This operation is useful for reorganizing your folder structure by changing the parent folder of a specified folder.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the folder to be moved.

parameters.name: newParentFolderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the new parent folder where the folder will be moved.

put.description: Rename an existing folder in the CRM lists by specifying the folder's ID and the new desired name. This can be useful for organizing and updating folder structures within your account.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the folder to be renamed.

parameters.name: newFolderName
parameters.description: The new name for the folder. It should be a string representing the desired folder name.

get.description: Retrieve the mapping of legacy list IDs to their current IDs in the HubSpot system. This endpoint is useful for migrating or updating systems that rely on legacy list identifiers.

parameters.name: legacyListId
parameters.description: The legacy list ID for which you want to retrieve the current ID mapping.

post.description: Map legacy list IDs to their corresponding new IDs in the HubSpot system. This endpoint is useful for migrating data from older systems to the current HubSpot structure, ensuring that all list references are updated correctly.

get.description: Retrieve a specific list by its name and object type ID in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access the details of a list, which can be useful for managing and analyzing your CRM data. You can also choose to include filters in the response.

parameters.name: listName
parameters.description: The name of the list to retrieve.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type associated with the list.

parameters.name: includeFilters
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include filters in the response. Defaults to false.

post.description: Retrieve batch membership information for records within specified lists. This endpoint is useful for obtaining membership details in bulk, allowing for efficient data retrieval when dealing with multiple records.

get.description: Retrieve the list memberships for a specific record within a specified object type. This endpoint is useful for understanding which lists a particular record is a member of, based on the object type and record ID provided.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type to which the record belongs.

parameters.name: recordId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the record for which memberships are being retrieved.

post.description: Search for lists within your HubSpot account using various criteria. This endpoint allows you to filter and retrieve lists based on specific search parameters, making it easier to manage and organize your lists effectively.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific list in your HubSpot account using the list's unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to optionally include filters associated with the list in the response.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list to retrieve.

parameters.name: includeFilters
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the list's filters in the response. Defaults to false.

delete.description: Delete a specific list in your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation will permanently remove the list and its associated data, ensuring it is no longer accessible.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list to delete.

get.description: Retrieve the memberships of a specific list in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through the list memberships using cursor-based pagination. It is useful for obtaining detailed membership information for a given list.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list whose memberships are to be retrieved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field to retrieve the next set of results.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use this to retrieve the previous set of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 100.

delete.description: Delete all memberships associated with a specific list in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you need to remove all members from a list, effectively clearing its membership data.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list whose memberships are to be deleted.

put.description: Add memberships to a specified list in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to add multiple memberships to a list identified by the listId. It is useful for managing list memberships in bulk, ensuring that the specified records are included in the list.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list to which memberships will be added.

put.description: Update the memberships of a list by adding and removing members in a single operation. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage list memberships by specifying which members to add and which to remove in one request.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list whose memberships are to be updated.

put.description: Add memberships to a specified list from another source list. This operation is useful for consolidating list memberships by transferring members from one list to another. The endpoint does not return any content upon successful execution.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the target list to which memberships will be added.

parameters.name: sourceListId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the source list from which memberships will be transferred.

get.description: Retrieve the join order of memberships for a specific list in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view the order in which records joined the list, which can be useful for tracking membership changes over time.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list whose membership join order is being retrieved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: A cursor token to retrieve results before a specific point in the list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 100.

put.description: Remove memberships from a specific list in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful for managing list memberships by removing specified records from the list. The request requires a list of record IDs to be removed from the specified list.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list from which memberships will be removed.

put.description: Restore a previously deleted list in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to recover lists that have been removed, ensuring that any associated data or configurations are reinstated. This can be useful for retrieving lists that were mistakenly deleted or are needed again for ongoing operations.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list to restore.

get.description: Retrieve the scheduled conversion details for a specific list in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about any scheduled conversions for the specified list, allowing you to manage and track list conversions effectively.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list for which the scheduled conversion details are to be retrieved.

put.description: Schedule a conversion for a specific list in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to set a conversion time for the list identified by the listId. Use this endpoint to manage the conversion schedule of your lists effectively.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list for which the conversion schedule is to be set.

delete.description: Delete a scheduled conversion for a specific list in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you need to cancel a previously scheduled conversion for a list identified by its listId.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list for which the scheduled conversion is to be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve the size and edits history of a specific list within a defined date range. This endpoint is useful for tracking changes and understanding the evolution of list size over time.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list for which the size and edits history is being retrieved.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for the history retrieval, formatted as a date-time string.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for the history retrieval, formatted as a date-time string.

put.description: Update the filters for a specific list in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the criteria used to include objects in the list. You can also specify whether objects should be enrolled in workflows based on the updated filters.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list whose filters are to be updated.

parameters.name: enrollObjectsInWorkflows
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to enroll objects in workflows based on the updated filters. Defaults to false.

put.description: Update the name of a specific list in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to change the list's name by specifying the new name as a query parameter. It is useful for keeping your lists organized and up-to-date with relevant titles.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the list whose name is to be updated.

parameters.name: includeFilters
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include filters in the response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: listName
parameters.description: The new name for the list. It should be a string representing the desired name.
